description: This Java source file defines the ResourceModified class, an immutable event class emitted after a Resource is modified within the Eclipse Ditto policies framework. It includes methods for creating instances, JSON serialization/deserialization, and accessors for event properties.

classes.name: ResourceModified
classes.description: Immutable event class representing a resource modification event in the Ditto policies framework, with JSON serialization/deserialization and property accessors.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods to create ResourceModified instances with various parameters, including deprecated string-based policy ID versions.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ResourceModified instance from JSON string or object.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label associated with the resource event.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Returns the resource associated with the event.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the resource entity.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path to the resource in the event payload.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated revision.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends event data to JSON payload builder.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code for the event.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the event.
